hero.title: A gracious Cape Dutch guesthouse in Hermanus
hero.lede: Five luxury en-suite rooms, a full breakfast on the veranda, a quiet garden and pool beneath the Klein River mountains — a short stroll from the cliff paths of Walker Bay.

story.heading: Old-world grace, hosted the way Hermanus used to be
story.para1: Behind its whitewashed gables in the leafy Eastcliff quarter, the Dorpshuys is a house of persian runners, button-back chairs and morning light — restored and run personally by Cecilia and Koos Pretorius.
story.para2: Both are experienced divers and qualified national tour guides, which means your hosts don't just check you in — they map out your whale watching, your Gansbaai shark dive and your Hemel-en-Aarde wine afternoon like locals who've done it all themselves.

rooms.heading: Five guest rooms in Eastcliff, each with its own character

items.name: The Garden Room
items.blurb: Button-back armchairs, a grand mahogany wardrobe and doors to the tranquil garden.

items.name: The Heritage Room
items.blurb: Crisp white linen, morning tea brought on a silver service, and the quiet of Eastcliff.

items.name: The Mountain Room
items.blurb: Gilt mirrors and soft light with the Klein River mountains standing over the rooftops.

reviews.quote: Beautiful old house, immaculate rooms and the warmest welcome we've had anywhere on the Garden Route trip.
Breakfast on the veranda with the mountains behind — worth the stay on its own. Cecilia's local tips made our whole weekend.
Walking distance to everything, yet completely quiet at night. The kind of guesthouse you plan a return trip around.
